enunciado: Create the class Fraction which simplifies itself in the constructor (using gcd) and has plus(other) and times(other) that return NEW fractions. Define toString() so print shows "n/d". Compute 1/2 + 1/3, 2/4 * 6/9 and 3/4 + 1/4.
objetivos: Design immutable objects that return new objects
pistas: Simplify by dividing numerator and denominator by their gcd.
